processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Overaging treatment (625 °C) for 192 h; κ-carbide particles are observed and sheared by the planar dislocation band. The large size and high-volume fraction of κ-carbide particles limit the chances of particles being sheared by planar dislocations, resulting in lower work hardening capacity compared with the short-time aging treated sample (aging time less than 10 h).

structures.overall_structure: Austenite matrix with κ-carbide particles (large size and high volume fraction); the κ-carbide particles are sheared by planar dislocation bands

defect_interactions.interaction_type: shearing of κ-carbide particles by planar dislocation bands
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: κ-carbide particles are observed and sheared by the planar dislocation band

interfaces.slip_behavior: planar dislocation band shearing of κ-carbide particles

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: work hardening capacity (lower than short-time aging treated sample, aging time less than 10 h)

unmapped_findings: For the overaged sample (overaging treatment at 625 °C for 192 h), the κ-carbide particles are observed and sheared by the planar dislocation band; the large size and high-volume fraction of the κ-carbide particles introduce limited chances of particles being sheared by planar dislocations, resulting in lower work hardening capacity compared with that of the short-time aging treated sample (aging time less than 10 h). The review concludes that the SRO strengthening mechanism is strongly influenced by the κ phase precipitation, thus the longtime aging treatment shall be avoided. (b0071)
